name: Hoshi wa Sora o Mitashite
source:
In my junior year of high school, I had to move away. 
Three days remained. Three faces lingered in my thoughts. 

We'd spent countless evenings staring at the sky as friends. 
Different grades, different genders. 

They were my special friends. One in particular. 

Yet after everything, they betrayed me? 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE097940.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
高三那年，我不得不搬走。还剩三天。三张面孔萦绕在我的脑海中。我们曾作为朋友一起度过了无数个仰望星空的夜晚。不同的年级，不同的性别。他们是我特别的朋友。尤其其中一个。然而在一切之后，他们背叛了我？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE097940.html]DLsite English[/url]]
